page.overview:
Who is Nana?

Nana was a character in The Graben Gang.

Nana attempted to drive a Sandworm away from the Graben when her son Duv told her that it could not be driven away as easily as a stray bat. Later when learned that a new security inspector named Rix to inspect Depot 12, she commented that she had once known a man with that name who had been well-endowned, much to the disgust of her son.

Nana overheard a conversation between Duv and Marika in which they discussed the upcoming Spice Cake Competition. Duv hinted at his secret ingredient, to what Nana shouted that if it was not more Spice he was wasting his time, prompting him to tell her to shut up.
